description: Defines which types of discovered AI assets can raise risk findings. When an active risk definition covers an asset type, the system raises applicable risk findings for that asset.

ID.description: ID is the identifier of the object.
ID.title: ID

disabled.description: If true, the risk definition is disabled.
disabled.title: disabled

findingDescription.description: The description that will be set on findings raised by this definition.
findingDescription.title: findingDescription

importHash.description: The hash of the structure used to compare with new import version.
importHash.title: importHash

importLabel.description: The user-defined import label that allows the system to group resources from the same import operation.
importLabel.title: importLabel

match.description: The list of predicates that define this risk pattern.
match.title: match

name.description: The internal reference name of the object. It is a sanitized version of Friendly Name if empty.
name.title: name

propagate.description: Propagates the object to all child namespaces. This is always true.
propagate.title: propagate

resolutionIdentities.description: The identities that can resolve findings raised by this definition.
resolutionIdentities.title: resolutionIdentities

system.description: If true, this is a system-seeded risk definition supplying finding identity for a risk pillar, and is excluded from customer opt-in matching.
system.title: system

type.description: Choose which asset kind the risk definition should apply to.
type.title: type

updateTime.description: Last update date of the object.
updateTime.title: updateTime

title: RiskDefinition
